questions.question: In FastAPI, what does `@app.get("/hello")` do?
options: Makes the function below answer GET requests to /hello
questions.explanation: Decorators like @app.get connect a URL path and HTTP method to your function.

questions.question: Where can you find FastAPI's automatic interactive documentation?
questions.explanation: FastAPI builds a /docs page from your code and type hints, and you can try every endpoint there.
